description: Interconnected Latin American Power System for Stability Assessment is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Pedro Gutierrez. "This database hosts simulation data for a prospective 2030 Latin American interconnected power system, as detailed in the study \"Breaking New Ground: Comprehensive Stability Assessment of Latin America's Interconnected Network.\" The data are provided in three DIgSILENT PowerFactory project files, compressed within a single archive named LA2030 Models.zip. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
